action.objective: Verify f4f5 as the single candidate: confirm exact score, king safety, and no forced Black mate reply.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search made f4f5 the top exact candidate (1797), reserving it for verification. Rival g4g6 is bound=upper, so its real value can be much worse; f4f5 keeps the pawn defended by the g4 rook, gains space, and its PV (f4f5 Kh7 Rh4+ Kg7) cuts the black king off. This single-candidate probe checks all Black replies for mate-in-one and forces-mate defenses before committing.
